summary: Active stubble burning cluster detected with 215 fires (FRP: 676 MW) and 99% emission strength. Smoke corridor approaches NCR receptor communities in ~0.5 hours, exposing an estimated 570,938 residents (90% CI: 428,203 - 713,672). Immediate protective interventions mandated for Government Senior Secondary School and A.D.Sr.Sec.School before threshold exceedance.
